verdict.rationale: Replicate is an API platform, so a versioned API with a documented deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version pinning, or any deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, and the llms.txt and docs.md probes show only getting-started and marketing content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
